title: Start/Stop with Foot Controller Plugged In
shortDescription: Trying to use start/stop button while foot controller is connected.
fullDescription:
Janome machines disable the start/stop button when foot controller is plugged in. Error 1 indicates this conflict.

Unplug foot controller to use start/stop button, or use pedal.

causes.cause: Pedal plugged in during start/stop use

fixSteps.title: Unplug pedal
fixSteps.instruction: Remove foot controller plug; start/stop will work.

videoSearchQuery: Janome sewing machine error 1 start stop pedal

title: Bobbin Winder Engaged
shortDescription: Bobbin winder spindle in winding position.
fullDescription:
Error 2 appears when bobbin winder is pushed right to wind bobbin, disabling sewing motor.

Push spindle left to resume sewing.
videoSearchQuery: Janome sewing machine error 2 bobbin winder

title: Presser Foot Up
shortDescription: Presser foot is up; lower before sewing.
fullDescription:
Error 3 appears when the machine detects presser foot in the up position during sewing attempt.

Lower the foot using the lever behind the needle.

fixSteps.title: Lower foot
fixSteps.instruction: Pull presser foot lever down fully.

videoSearchQuery: Janome sewing machine error 3 presser foot

title: Thread Tension Sensor Error
fullDescription:
Top tension sensor detects thread outside safe tension range. Usually threading issue or tension disc lint.

Rethread with foot up, clean tension discs.

fixSteps.title: Rethread
fixSteps.instruction: With foot up, rethread top thread carefully.

fixSteps.title: Clean tension
fixSteps.instruction: Use thread piece to floss tension discs.

whenToCallPro: If persists after rethread and cleaning.

title: Bobbin Winding Problem
shortDescription: Bobbin won't wind or winds unevenly.
fullDescription:
Bobbin fails to wind due to incorrect threading path, engaged clutch, or full bobbin.

Follow winding path exactly and verify bobbin is not full.

fixSteps.title: Check clutch
fixSteps.instruction: For older models, release handwheel clutch.

faq.a: Check model manual; some use class J.

title: Foot Controller Fault
fullDescription:
Foot controller not working due to connection issue or internal fault.

Check plug and test with known-good controller if available.

fixSteps.title: Reseat plug
fixSteps.instruction: Unplug and firmly plug controller in.

fixSteps.title: Replace
fixSteps.instruction: Test with new controller if problem persists.

faq.a: Use Janome OEM for your model.

title: Needle Broken
fullDescription:
Sensors detected a broken needle. Safety shutdown engages.

Remove broken needle pieces, install new needle, check for damage to hook.

title: Custom Pattern Memory Full
fullDescription:
You've saved maximum custom patterns. Must delete some to save more.

Go to memory menu and delete unused patterns.

title: Needle Threader Problem
fullDescription:
Automatic threader hook bent, needle wrong position, or threader needs adjustment.

Raise needle fully and check threader alignment.
videoSearchQuery: Janome automatic needle threader not working

title: LCD Screen Issue
shortDescription: Display shows garbled or frozen content.
fullDescription:
LCD display malfunction: blank, garbled, or frozen. Try power cycle; may indicate hardware issue.

Service needed if power cycle doesn't resolve.

faq.a: Usually yes if under warranty period.
